name: Winmate M101AD-EX
summary: The Winmate M101AD-EX is the hazardous-area version of a Winmate rugged 10.1-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2 under IECEx. Winmate also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC.

otherSchemes: KCs Ex ic IIC T4 Gc (Korea)

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 3 (2025-11-18), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX number not published; UKEX not found

certification.northAmerica: Class I, Division 2, Groups A, B, C, D, T4 (datasheet)

safety.conditions: Charge only in the non-hazardous area with the adapter or cradle supplied by the manufacturer. Protect from liquid and dust contamination (pollution degree 2 or better). Connecting or disconnecting external ports, opening the enclosure or replacing the battery pack is permitted only when the explosive atmosphere is shown to be absent. Periodically inspect the interior where condensation can occur. USB-A, USB-C, audio output, RJ45 and DC-in may be used only in safe areas. In hazardous areas the tablet must be secured by a Kensington lock with a suitable string length so it cannot be carried out of a pollution degree 2 area.
safety.peripherals: USB-A, USB-C, audio output, RJ45 and DC-in only in safe areas (certificate). Other port, SD and SIM operations only when the atmosphere is shown to be absent.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Certificate names only the manufacturer battery pack, the supplied 19 V adapter and cradle (charging outside hazardous areas) and a Kensington lock. Datasheet accessories (desk dock, vehicle dock, vehicle cradle, vehicle charger, hand strap, shoulder strap, carry bag) carry no Ex marking; no keyboard.
